newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sunkyong in Indonesia finance venture. [CORRECTED 06:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sunkyong in Indonesia finance venture. [CORRECTED 06:45 GMT]

text.p: South Korea's Sunkyong Ltd said on Wednesday it has agreed with its sister firm Sunkyong Industry Co Ltd, one Indonesian group and an Indonesian bank on a joint venture to set up a multi-finance company there. (Corrects to show one of the two Indonesian entities is a company.)
A Sunkyong statement said it would hold a 59 percent stake in the joint venture and Sunkyong Industry a 15 percent share.
Indonesia's Tamara Bank PT and Rimba Group (corrects from Rimba Bank) will hold 21 percent and five percent respectively.
The joint venture, PT SK Tamara Finance, will have a paid-in capital of $11 million (corrects from $1.1 million) and plans to start operation in August.
